sections.title: The rules
paragraphs: Every figure carries its source and its time. "As of" is the time the data describes; "retrieved" is when CCTools read it.
Gaps stay gaps: a value that was not recorded is empty, never zero, and every empty value in a final row has a reason in gaps.csv.
History is corrected after publication, in the open: every change to a final value is a row in revisions.csv.

sections.title: The daily record
paragraphs: A day is a UTC day D: [D 00:00:00Z, D+1 00:00:00Z). Snapshot series are the state at D+1 00:00:00Z, so a snapshot minus the previous day's snapshot is the flow of day D.
A mining round belongs to day D when the record time of its AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing exercise falls in D. first_round and last_round are published so anyone can recompute a day.
A value is provisional until its day has settled, then final: provisional by D+1 01:00 UTC and final by D+1 03:00 UTC, as a target.

rows: Lowest mining round assigned to the day. A round belongs to day D when the record time of its AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing exercise falls in D (UTC).
ACS snapshot, IssuingMiningRound (and StartIssuing record times)
Highest mining round assigned to the day. A round belongs to day D when the record time of its AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing exercise falls in D (UTC).
ACS snapshot, IssuingMiningRound (and StartIssuing record times)
Number of rounds assigned to the day, last_round - first_round + 1, checked for contiguity with the previous day.
ACS snapshot, IssuingMiningRound (and StartIssuing record times)
Total Canton Coin supply at the end of the day (D+1 00:00:00Z): the Scan token registry's totalSupply whose totalSupplyAsOf is that instant.
supply_cc(D) - supply_cc(D-1). Not issuance minus burn: minting is lumpy and burn can exceed it on a given day.
SV-voted Canton Coin price (amuletPrice, the median of Super Validator votes) of the highest-numbered OpenMiningRound in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z. Not a market price.
Issuance scheduled by the day's rounds: the sum of the seven category columns. Not minted supply.
Featured-app reward issuance of the day's rounds: totalFeaturedAppRewardCoupons x issuancePerFeaturedAppRewardCoupon, as fixed at StartIssuing.
Validator reward issuance of the day's rounds: totalValidatorRewardCoupons x issuancePerValidatorRewardCoupon.
Super Validator reward issuance of the day's rounds: totalSvRewardWeight x issuancePerSvRewardCoupon.
Development Fund share of the day's rounds: the amount of each UnclaimedDevelopmentFundCoupon created at StartIssuing.
Validator faucet issuance: optTotalValidatorFaucetCoupons x optIssuancePerValidatorFaucetCoupon. A measured zero while the faucet cap is 0.
Issuance not assigned to any coupon: the amount of the UnclaimedReward created at StartIssuing, read from its own event, never computed as a remainder.
Members of DsoRules.svs in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z.
Votes a DSO action needs for that membership: ceiling((n + f + 1) / 2) with f = floor((n - 1) / 3), as Splice DsoRules.daml summarizeDso computes it.
Active FeaturedAppRight contracts in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z (contracts, not distinct providers).
Active ValidatorLicense contracts in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z. A new series: not the validator_count of Loop Data (formerly Lighthouse), by Five North.

Featured-app reward coupons of the day's rounds: the sum of totalFeaturedAppRewardCoupons in each round's AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing summary. app_rewards_cc is each round's total times its issuancePerFeaturedAppRewardCoupon. A sum of coupon amounts, not a count of apps or transactions. Empty, as not collected, before the forward collector's first full day; the update-stream backfill is planned.

Validator reward coupons of the day's rounds: the sum of totalValidatorRewardCoupons in each round's AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing summary. validator_rewards_cc is each round's total times its issuancePerValidatorRewardCoupon. A sum of coupon amounts, not a count of validators. Empty, as not collected, before the forward collector's first full day; the update-stream backfill is planned.

sections.title: Sources
paragraphs: Canton Scan (the Splice Scan API that Super Validators serve), read through api.cantonnodes.com. This is a single operator until a second Super Validator source is added; the host is recorded on every value.
api.cantonnodes.com: Canton Nodes, powered by Proof Group, a Super Validator; a commercial service whose free tier is rate limited, with no published terms of service or data license.

Scan data is observable by any onboarded validator through Scan, and publicly through third-party Scan proxies. When two Super Validator scans are available, each day's snapshot series will be read from both and compared.
Loop Data and market price providers are not sources of the record.

sections.title: Gaps
paragraphs: Every empty value in a final row joins a reason in gaps.csv, or the day stays provisional and an alert fires.

rows: Before this series was collected; a backfill may be planned.

sections.title: Corrections and revisions
paragraphs: A final value changes only as a logged revision: backfill (empty to value), correction (a new value, with its source host and as-of time), withdrawal (value to empty, with a new gap) or method (a new value recomputed under a new method version). A recomputation that gives the same value is not a revision: the value keeps its revision number, source host and as-of time. The database enforces this.
A withdrawn value stays empty until a correction restores it: the daily jobs never put a withdrawn number back.

Method versions: scan-1 (forward StartIssuing capture and the D+1 00:00Z ACS snapshot); scan-rt-1 (reserved for the archived round-totals endpoint, which was checked against the StartIssuing split and matches it for neither app nor validator rewards: its app rewards exceed the featured-app pool a round can issue, consistent with counting rewards collected rather than issued, so nothing from it is published).
Backfill before the first public release (2026-10) is part of release 0; revision counters start at 0 on release day.

sections.title: How to cite
paragraphs: Each day page and days/YYYY-MM-DD.json carry a plain citation and a BibTeX entry; replace {retrieved} with the date you read it.
Dataset: CCTools (2026). CCTools daily record of the Canton Network, schema 1.0.0, release 2026-10.

sections.title: Reproducibility
paragraphs: first_round and last_round let anyone recompute a day's issuance from Scan. status.json lists the sha256 of every file for the last 24 generations.

sections.title: Known limitations
paragraphs: The reference price is the Super Validators' voted price, not a market price.

Issuance is what the rounds schedule, not minted supply: unclaimed rewards are not minted and some shares are minted only when claimed, so net supply change can be negative or larger than a day's issuance.
Burn and transaction counts are not in schema 1.0.0; they arrive as new columns when measured.

Reward coupon totals start with the forward collector: the round-totals archive does not carry them, so earlier days are empty (not collected) until the update-stream backfill. A coupon total is a sum of coupon amounts, not a count of apps, validators or transactions.
Single operator until a second Super Validator source is added. App rewards and app reward coupons change method when the network switches reward versions (CIP-104).

sections.title: Before the open record
paragraphs: CCTools kept an earlier daily table copied from a third-party indexer (Loop Data). It is not carried into this record, and its defects are listed here so the history is not hidden:
On 2026-08-14 a missing column stopped the daily write, which is why that date is absent.
Its supply figure stayed frozen at one value from mid-August 2026, about 5% below the registry supply.
In September 2026 several values are empty because the indexer answered 401 or 429 on those days.
